about:
Cooper Fabrication Inc. was founded in 2002 in Post Falls, Idaho, as a family-run welding, repair, and fabrication shop. The company operates a brick-and-mortar facility in Post Falls and deploys several fully equipped mobile units to serve customers across Coeur d’Alene, Kootenai County, greater North Idaho, Spokane, and eastern Washington.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication and welding in carbon steel, aluminum, and stainless steel using MIG, TIG, and stick processes. Core services include portable line boring and bore welding for heavy machinery repair, custom fabrication for trucks, trailers, gates, handrails, and marine components, as well as commercial, industrial, residential, and agricultural work. The facility is supported by a large fabrication shop and mobile units that enable on-site repairs and installations.

Customers span heavy equipment operators, trucking fleets, construction firms, farms, and residential clients throughout the Inland Northwest. The company holds contractor licenses in both Idaho and Washington, carries full insurance, and employs certified welders. It also acts as an authorized dealer for SnowDogg plows, B&W trailer hitches, and SwapLoader hook-lift systems.

The owner brings 30 years of fabrication and design experience, and the business emphasizes high-quality work completed on schedule at a reasonable cost. The combination of in-shop capacity and mobile response is presented as a key differentiator for clients needing rapid turnaround on repairs or custom builds.
